description: This file defines a Symfony console command 'RunMigrationClassCommand' that facilitates running database migration classes within the OrangeHRM system. It includes configuration, execution logic, and integration with the application's framework to perform migrations safely with checks and status reporting.

classes.name: RunMigrationClassCommand
classes.description: A Symfony console command class that executes a specified database migration class within the OrangeHRM system, handling setup, validation, execution, and status reporting.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command's description, help text, and required argument 'className'.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the migration process: checks installation, validates migration class, runs the migration, updates configs, and reports status.
